### `src/pages/SurvivorTestimonyView.jsx`

```jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import Layout from '../components/Layout';
import survivorData from '../data/survivorTestimony.json';
import './SurvivorTestimonyView.css';

function PinIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
      <path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12s-8-6-8-12a8 8 0 0 1 16 0Z" />
      <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function LanguageIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
      <path d="M2 12h20M12 2a15 15 0 0 1 0 20 15 15 0 0 1 0-20Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function PlayIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
      <polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function ExternalLinkIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
      <path d="M18 13v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6" />
      <path d="M15 3h6v6M10 14 21 3" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function ArrowLeftIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
      <line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12" />
      <polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** Normalizes item_url, which may be a string, an array, or null. */
function getLinks(itemUrl) {
  if (!itemUrl) return [];
  return Array.isArray(itemUrl) ? itemUrl : [itemUrl];
}

/** Extracts a YouTube video ID from watch, youtu.be, or embed-style URLs. */
function getYouTubeId(url) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (u.hostname.includes('youtu.be')) {
      return u.pathname.slice(1).split('/')[0] || null;
    }
    if (u.hostname.includes('youtube.com')) {
      if (u.pathname === '/watch') return u.searchParams.get('v');
      if (u.pathname.startsWith('/embed/')) return u.pathname.split('/embed/')[1]?.split('/')[0] || null;
      if (u.pathname.startsWith('/shorts/')) return u.pathname.split('/shorts/')[1]?.split('/')[0] || null;
    }
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  return null;
}

function splitAroundPlaceholder(text, placeholder) {
  const marker = `{${placeholder}}`;
  const index = text.indexOf(marker);
  if (index === -1) return [text, null, ''];
  return [
    text.slice(0, index),
    marker,
    text.slice(index + marker.length),
  ];
}

export default function SurvivorTestimonyView() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const testimonies = survivorData.testimonies || [];
  const testimony = testimonies.find((item) => item.id === id);
  const links = getLinks(testimony?.item_url);

  // Which link (by index) is currently showing inline, if any.
  // Auto-open when there's exactly one link, since there's no ambiguity to resolve.
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(links.length === 1 ? 0 : null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveIndex(links.length === 1 ? 0 : null);
  }, [id, links.length]);

  if (!testimony) {
    return (
      <Layout>
        <div className="testimony-view-page">
          <div className="testimony-view-not-found">
            <h2>{t('testimonies.notFound')}</h2>
            <p>{t('testimonies.notFoundDesc')}</p>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/testimonies')} className="testimony-view-back-btn">
              <ArrowLeftIcon />
              {t('testimonies.backToTestimonies')}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Layout>
    );
  }

  const activeUrl = activeIndex !== null ? links[activeIndex] : null;
  const activeYouTubeId = activeUrl ? getYouTubeId(activeUrl) : null;

  const notAvailableTemplate = t('testimonies.notAvailableDesc', { link: '{link}', id: testimony.id });
  const [notAvailableBefore, , notAvailableAfter] = splitAroundPlaceholder(notAvailableTemplate, 'link');

  const aboutArchiveTemplate = t('testimonies.aboutArchiveDesc', { link: '{link}' });
  const [aboutBefore, , aboutAfter] = splitAroundPlaceholder(aboutArchiveTemplate, 'link');

  return (
    <Layout>
      <div className="testimony-view-page">
        <div className="testimony-view-container">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => navigate('/testimonies')}
            className="testimony-view-back-btn"
          >
            <ArrowLeftIcon />
            {t('testimonies.backToTestimonies')}
          </button>

          <div className="testimony-view-header">
            <div className="testimony-view-badge">{t('testimonies.badge')}</div>
            <h1 className="testimony-view-title">{testimony.title || 'Testimony'}</h1>

            <div className="testimony-view-meta">
              {testimony.district && (
                <span className="testimony-view-meta-item">
                  <PinIcon />
                  {testimony.district} District
                </span>
              )}
              {testimony.language && (
                <span className="testimony-view-meta-item">
                  <LanguageIcon />
                  {testimony.language}
                  {testimony.translation ? ` · ${testimony.translation}` : ''}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="testimony-view-content">
            <div className="testimony-view-summary">
              <h2>{t('testimonies.summaryTitle')}</h2>
              <p>{testimony.summary || 'No summary available.'}</p>
            </div>

            {links.length > 0 && (
              <div className="testimony-view-links">
                <h2>{t('testimonies.accessTitle')}</h2>
                <p className="testimony-view-links-intro">
                  {t('testimonies.accessIntro')}
                </p>

                {/* Player renders in place, above the trigger buttons, so playing
                    a testimony never navigates the visitor off the page. */}
                {activeYouTubeId && (
                  <div className="testimony-video-embed">
                    <iframe
                      src={`https://www.youtube.com/embed/${activeYouTubeId}?rel=0`}
                      title={testimony.title || 'Testimony video'}
                      allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"
                      allowFullScreen
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="testimony-view-links-list">
                  {links.map((url, i) => {
                    const youTubeId = getYouTubeId(url);
                    const isActive = activeIndex === i;
                    const label =
                      links.length > 1 ? t('testimonies.part', { part: i + 1 }) : t('testimonies.viewFull');

                    return youTubeId ? (
                      <button
                        key={url}
                        type="button"
                        className={`testimony-view-link${isActive ? ' testimony-view-link--active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => setActiveIndex(isActive ? null : i)}
                        aria-pressed={isActive}
                      >
                        <PlayIcon />
                        {isActive ? t('testimonies.hideVideo') : label}
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      // Non-YouTube links can't be embedded — these still open
                      // externally, but explicitly in a new tab.
                      <a
                        key={url}
                        href={url}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="testimony-view-link"
                      >
                        <ExternalLinkIcon />
                        {label}
                      </a>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {!testimony.item_url && (
              <div className="testimony-view-note">
                <h2>{t('testimonies.notAvailable')}</h2>
                <p>
                  {notAvailableBefore}
                  <a
                    href={testimony.listing_url}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="testimony-view-archive-link"
                  >
                    {t('testimonies.archiveLink')}
                  </a>
                  {notAvailableAfter}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="testimony-view-archive">
              <h2>{t('testimonies.aboutArchive')}</h2>
              <p>
                {aboutBefore}
                <a
                  href={testimony.listing_url}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="testimony-view-archive-link"
                >
                  {t('testimonies.searchLink')}
                </a>
                {aboutAfter}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Layout>
  );
}
```

### `src/pages/Videos.css`

```css
/* ── VIDEOS PAGE ── */
.videos-page {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: start;
  padding-bottom: 80px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .videos-page {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .video-panel {
    position: static;
  }
  .featured-video h1 {
    font-size: 22px;
  }
  .video-cards {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .featured-video {
    padding: 20px;
  }
  .featured-video h1 {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  .featured-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .play-btn, .library-btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }
}

/* ── FEATURED VIDEO ── */
.featured-video {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--text-primary) 40%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px 28px 24px;
  color: white;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 200px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.featured-video::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, rgba(200, 120, 40, 0.25) 0%, transparent 60%);
}

.featured-video-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  position: relative;
}

/* Reuse styles from Listen.css */
.featured-badge {
  background: var(--accent-gold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.featured-duration {
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.7;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.featured-video h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  position: relative;
  max-width: 560px;
}

.featured-video p {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  opacity: 0.8;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}

.featured-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  position: relative;
}

.play-btn {
  background: var(--primary);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

.play-btn:hover {
  background: var(--primary-dark);
}

.library-btn {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  color: white;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

.library-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

/* ── VIDEOS SECTION ── */
.videos-section {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.videos-section-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.videos-section-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
}

.videos-view-all {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.video-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.video-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 12px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
}

.video-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.video-thumb {
  width: 120px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.video-thumb img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.video-play-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: white;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.video-card:hover .video-play-overlay {
  opacity: 1;
}

.video-info {
  flex: 1;
}

.video-genre {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.video-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.video-narrator {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.video-duration {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* ── RIGHT PANEL: VIDEO PLAYER ── */
.video-panel {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: sticky;
  top: calc(var(--topbar-height) + 16px);
}

.video-player {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text-primary), var(--primary-dark));
}

.video-player img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.video-empty-player {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.video-play-center {
  position: absolute;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

.video-play-center:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}

.player-info {
  padding: 14px 16px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.player-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.player-narrator {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.player-controls {
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.player-progress {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.player-time {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.progress-bar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--primary);
  border-radius: 3px;
  width: 28%;
  position: relative;
}

.progress-fill::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  right: -4px;
  top: -3px;
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  background: var(--primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.player-btns {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.player-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: all 0.15s;
}

.player-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.player-btn.play-pause {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: white;
}

.player-btn.play-pause:hover {
  background: var(--primary-dark);
}

.player-extra {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.player-speed {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: var(--bg-main);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.player-extra-icons {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.player-icon-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  padding: 4px;
  transition: color 0.15s;
}

.player-icon-btn:hover {
  color: var(--primary);
}
```

### `src/pages/Videos.jsx`

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import Layout from '../components/Layout';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { useGamificationContext } from '../contexts/GamificationContext';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { apiUrl, apiFetch } from '../config/api';
import FlagControl from '../components/FlagControl';
import './Videos.css';
import { localizeItem } from '../utils/contentLocale';

export default function Videos() {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const { awardXP } = useGamificationContext();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [currentVideo, setCurrentVideo] = useState(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(0);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const [awardedItems, setAwardedItems] = useState(new Set());
  const [savingVideoId, setSavingVideoId] = useState(null);
  const [reportMessage, setReportMessage] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchVideos = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(apiUrl('/api/video'));
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.video && data.video.length > 0) {
          const mapped = data.video.map((v) => ({
            id: v.id,
            genre: v.category,
            title: v.title,
            narrator: v.description,
            duration: v.duration ? `${Math.floor(v.duration / 60)}:${(v.duration % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}` : '00:00',
            durationSec: v.duration || 0,
            image: v.thumbnail_url || '',
            videoUrl: v.video_url || '',
          }));
          setVideos(mapped);
        } else {
          setVideos([]);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching videos:', err);
        setVideos([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchVideos();
  }, [t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const pending = localStorage.getItem('pendingVideoPlay');
    if (!pending || videos.length === 0) return;
    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(pending);
      localStorage.removeItem('pendingVideoPlay');
      const video = videos.find(v => String(v.id) === String(payload.itemId));
      if (video) playVideo(video);
    } catch {
      localStorage.removeItem('pendingVideoPlay');
    }
  }, [videos]);

  const playVideo = useCallback((video) => {
    if (!video.videoUrl) {
      alert("No video file available for this item yet.");
      return;
    }
    setCurrentVideo(video);
    setIsPlaying(true);
    if (videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.src = video.videoUrl;
      videoRef.current.load();
      videoRef.current.play().catch(e => console.error("Playback failed:", e));
    }
  }, []);

  const togglePlayPause = useCallback(() => {
    if (!videoRef.current || !currentVideo) return;
    if (isPlaying) {
      videoRef.current.pause();
    } else {
      videoRef.current.play().catch(e => console.error("Playback failed:", e));
    }
    setIsPlaying(p => !p);
  }, [isPlaying, currentVideo]);

  const handleTimeUpdate = useCallback(() => {
    if (videoRef.current) {
      setCurrentTime(videoRef.current.currentTime);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleLoadedMetadata = useCallback(() => {
    if (videoRef.current) {
      setDuration(videoRef.current.duration);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleEnded = useCallback(() => {
    setIsPlaying(false);
    setCurrentTime(0);
  }, []);

  const handleVideoClick = useCallback((video) => {
    playVideo(video);
    if (!awardedItems.has(video.title)) {
      awardXP(25, `Watched video: ${video.title}`);
      setAwardedItems(prev => new Set([...prev, video.title]));
    }
  }, [awardedItems, awardXP, playVideo]);

  const handleAddToLibrary = useCallback(async (video) => {
    if (!user) {
      alert("Please sign in to save to your library.");
      return;
    }
    if (!video.videoUrl) {
      alert("No video file available for this item yet.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
      if (!token) {
        alert("Please sign in to save to your library.");
        return;
      }
      const res = await apiFetch('/api/saved', {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          itemType: "video",
          itemId: Number(video.id),
          itemTitle: video.title,
          itemSubtitle: video.narrator,
          itemImage: video.image || "",
          itemMeta: { duration: video.duration, videoUrl: video.videoUrl },
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.error || `Failed to save (${res.status})`);
      }
      setSavingVideoId(video.id);
      setTimeout(() => setSavingVideoId(null), 1500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Save to library failed:", err);
      alert(err.message || "Failed to add to library.");
    }
  }, [user]);

  const formatTime = (secs) => {
    if (!secs || !Number.isFinite(secs)) return "0:00";
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(secs % 60);
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  };

  const progressPercent = duration > 0 ? (currentTime / duration) * 100 : 0;

  // Translate video card text based on active language
  const localizedVideos = useMemo(() =>
    videos.map(v => localizeItem(v, language)),
    [videos, language]
  );

  // Translate the currently-playing video title/desc too
  const localizedCurrentVideo = useMemo(() =>
    currentVideo ? localizeItem(currentVideo, language) : null,
    [currentVideo, language]
  );

  return (
    <Layout searchPlaceholder={t('search.placeholder')}>
      <div className="videos-page">
        <div>
          <div className="featured-video">
            <div className="featured-video-meta">
              <span className="featured-badge">{t('videos.featured')}</span>
              <span className="featured-duration">
                <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                  <polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14" />
                </svg>
                {currentVideo ? formatTime(duration) : '0:00'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h1>{currentVideo ? currentVideo.title : 'No video selected'}</h1>
            <p>{currentVideo ? currentVideo.narrator : 'Add videos in the admin dashboard to publish them here.'}</p>
            <div className="featured-actions">
              <button className="play-btn" onClick={togglePlayPause}>
                <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                  {isPlaying
                    ? <>
                        <rect x="6" y="4" width="4" height="16" />
                        <rect x="14" y="4" width="4" height="16" />
                      </>
                    : <polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3" />
                  }
                </svg>
                {isPlaying ? t('videos.pause') : t('videos.watchNow')}
              </button>
              <button
                className="library-btn"
                onClick={() => currentVideo && handleAddToLibrary(currentVideo)}
                disabled={savingVideoId === currentVideo?.id}
                style={{ opacity: currentVideo ? 1 : 0.6, cursor: currentVideo ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed' }}
              >
                {savingVideoId === currentVideo?.id ? 'Saved ✓' : t('videos.addToLibrary')}
              </button>
              {currentVideo && (
                <FlagControl
                  type="video"
                  itemId={currentVideo.id}
                  title={currentVideo.title}
                  onToast={(text) => { setReportMessage(text); setTimeout(() => setReportMessage(''), 3000); }}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="videos-section">
            <div className="videos-section-header">
              <span className="videos-section-title">{t('videos.traditionalPerformances')}</span>
              <span className="videos-view-all">{t('videos.viewAll')}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="video-cards">
              {loading ? (
                <p>Loading videos...</p>
              ) : videos.length === 0 ? (
                <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>No videos available yet.</p>
              ) : (
                videos.map((video, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="video-card" onClick={() => handleVideoClick(video)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    <div className="video-thumb">
                      {video.image ? <img src={video.image} alt={video.title} /> : null}
                      <div className="video-play-overlay" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleVideoClick(video); }}>
                        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                          <polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="video-info">
                      <div className="video-genre">{video.genre}</div>
                      <div className="video-title">{video.title}</div>
                      <div className="video-narrator">{video.narrator}</div>
                      <div className="video-duration">{video.duration}</div>
                      <FlagControl
                        type="video"
                        itemId={video.id}
                        title={video.title}
                        onToast={(text) => { setReportMessage(text); setTimeout(() => setReportMessage(''), 3000); }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="video-panel">
          <div className="video-player">
            {currentVideo ? (
              <video
                ref={videoRef}
                src={currentVideo.videoUrl}
                style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', display: 'block' }}
                onTimeUpdate={handleTimeUpdate}
                onLoadedMetadata={handleLoadedMetadata}
                onEnded={handleEnded}
                preload="metadata"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="video-empty-player">No video selected</div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="player-info">
            <div className="player-title">{currentVideo ? currentVideo.title : 'No video selected'}</div>
            <div className="player-narrator">{currentVideo ? (currentVideo.narrator || currentVideo.genre) : 'Use the admin dashboard to add videos.'}</div>
          </div>
          <div className="player-controls">
            <div className="player-progress">
              <div className="player-time">
                <span>{formatTime(currentTime)}</span>
                <span>{formatTime(duration)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="progress-bar">
                <div className="progress-fill" style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="player-btns">
              <button className="player-btn" onClick={() => { if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.currentTime = Math.max(0, currentTime - 10); }}>
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <polygon points="19 20 9 12 19 4 19 20" />
                  <line x1="5" y1="19" x2="5" y2="5" />
                </svg>
              </button>
              <button className="player-btn play-pause" onClick={togglePlayPause}>
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                  {isPlaying
                    ? <>
                        <rect x="6" y="4" width="4" height="16" />
                        <rect x="14" y="4" width="4" height="16" />
                      </>
                    : <polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3" />
                  }
                </svg>
              </button>
              <button className="player-btn" onClick={() => { if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.currentTime = Math.min(duration, currentTime + 10); }}>
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <polygon points="5 4 15 12 5 20 5 4" />
                  <line x1="19" y1="5" x2="19" y2="19" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="player-extra">
            <span className="player-speed">⊙ 1.0x</span>
            <div className="player-extra-icons">
              <button className="player-icon-btn">
                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5" />
                  <path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 010 7.07" />
                  <path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 010 14.14" />
                </svg>
              </button>
              <button className="player-icon-btn">
                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3" />
                  <circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3" />
                  <circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3" />
                  <line x1="8.59" y1="13.51" x2="15.42" y2="17.49" />
                  <line x1="15.41" y1="6.51" x2="8.59" y2="10.49" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {reportMessage && <div className="contribute-toast">{reportMessage}</div>}
    </Layout>
  );
}
```

### `src/pages/admin/Admin.css`

```css
.admin-page {
  --admin-primary: #8D493A;
  --admin-primary-dark: #3E2723;
  --admin-primary-soft: #FCDFD3;
  --admin-bg: #FDFBF7;
  --admin-card: #FFFFFF;
  --admin-text: #2C1A14;
  --admin-secondary: #6F5B55;
  --admin-muted: #8A7B73;
  --admin-border: #EADBC8;
  --admin-border-light: #F1ECE6;
  --admin-gold: #C49B1C;
  --admin-gold-soft: #FEF9E7;
  --admin-green: #2E7D45;
  --admin-green-soft: #E8F5ED;
  --admin-red: #B71C1C;
  --admin-red-soft: #FFEBEE;
  --admin-blue: #1558A8;
  --admin-blue-soft: #EBF2FF;
  color: var(--admin-text);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 90%;
}

.admin-command-header {
  align-items: flex-start;
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.admin-command-header h1 {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-command-header p {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 3px 0 0;
}

.admin-header-actions,
.admin-content-switch,
.admin-quick-actions {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.admin-btn,
.admin-primary,
.admin-danger,
.admin-content-switch button {
  align-items: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 9px 18px;
  transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-btn-primary,
.admin-primary,
.admin-content-switch button.active {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(141, 73, 58, .3);
  color: #FDFBF7;
}

.admin-btn-ghost,
.admin-content-switch button {
  background: var(--admin-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
}

.admin-danger {
  background: var(--admin-red-soft);
  color: var(--admin-red);
  padding: 7px 13px;
}

.admin-danger:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.45;
}

.admin-message {
  background: var(--admin-gold-soft);
  border: 1px solid rgba(196, 155, 28, 0.28);
  border-radius: 12px;
  color: #6F5511;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 13px 16px;
}

.admin-search-results {
  background: var(--admin-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(44, 26, 20, .06);
  padding: 18px;
}

.admin-search-results p {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-search-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-search-group {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 12px;
  text-align: left;
}

.admin-search-group strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.admin-search-group span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: -webkit-box;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
}

.admin-main-pane {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-kpi,
.admin-chart-card,
.admin-panel {
  background: var(--admin-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(44, 26, 20, .06);
}

.admin-kpi {
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 22px 24px;
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

.admin-kpi:hover,
.admin-quick-action:hover,
.admin-chart-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(44, 26, 20, .10);
}

.admin-kpi::before {
  background: var(--kpi-soft, var(--admin-primary-soft));
  border-radius: 50%;
  bottom: -20px;
  content: "";
  height: 90px;
  opacity: .15;
  position: absolute;
  right: -20px;
  width: 90px;
}

.admin-kpi-primary { --kpi-soft: var(--admin-primary-soft); --kpi-fg: var(--admin-primary); }
.admin-kpi-green { --kpi-soft: var(--admin-green-soft); --kpi-fg: var(--admin-green); }
.admin-kpi-gold { --kpi-soft: var(--admin-gold-soft); --kpi-fg: var(--admin-gold); }
.admin-kpi-blue { --kpi-soft: var(--admin-blue-soft); --kpi-fg: var(--admin-blue); }

.admin-kpi-icon {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--kpi-soft, var(--admin-primary-soft));
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--kpi-fg, var(--admin-primary));
  display: flex;
  height: 40px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  width: 40px;
}

.admin-kpi span,
.admin-field span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .8px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-kpi strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  display: block;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}

.admin-kpi small {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 11px;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.admin-kpi small b {
  color: var(--admin-green);
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-kpi small b.down {
  color: var(--admin-red);
}

.admin-quick-actions {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-quick-action {
  background: var(--admin-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

.admin-quick-action:hover {
  border-color: var(--admin-primary);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.admin-quick-action span {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--admin-primary-soft);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-primary);
  display: flex;
  height: 36px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 10px;
  width: 36px;
}

.admin-overview-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;
}

.admin-overview-left,
.admin-overview-side {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.admin-overview-side {
  gap: 16px;
}

.admin-chart-card,
.admin-panel {
  padding: 24px;
}

.admin-card-sm {
  padding: 18px;
}

.admin-section-title,
.admin-chart-title {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--admin-text);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  text-transform: none;
}

.admin-section-title span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.admin-activity-chart {
  align-items: flex-end;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 120px;
}

.admin-activity-col {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 100%;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.admin-activity-bar {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--admin-primary) 0%, var(--admin-primary-soft) 100%);
  border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  min-height: 4px;
  width: 100%;
}

.admin-activity-bar.gold {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--admin-gold) 0%, #FAE78A 100%);
}

.admin-activity-col span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding-top: 6px;
}

.admin-chart-legend {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.admin-chart-legend span {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  gap: 5px;
}

.admin-chart-legend i {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  border-radius: 2px;
  height: 8px;
  width: 8px;
}

.admin-chart-legend i.gold {
  background: var(--admin-gold);
}

.admin-usage-proof {
  padding: 20px;
}

.admin-usage-bars {
  align-items: end;
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(86px, 1fr));
  min-height: 220px;
  padding-top: 12px;
}

.admin-usage-bar-item {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
  justify-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-usage-bar-track {
  align-items: end;
  background: #F5EFE9;
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: flex;
  height: 138px;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 5px;
  width: 24px;
}

.admin-usage-bar-track span {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--admin-primary), var(--admin-primary-dark));
  border-radius: inherit;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
}

.admin-usage-bar-track span.green {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #45A363, var(--admin-green));
}

.admin-usage-bar-track span.gold {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E2BA35, var(--admin-gold));
}

.admin-usage-bar-track span.blue {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2E75C7, var(--admin-blue));
}

.admin-usage-bar-track span.muted {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #9C8A7E, #6F5B55);
}

.admin-usage-bar-item strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.admin-usage-bar-item small,
.admin-usage-note {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-usage-note {
  margin: 16px 0 0;
}

.admin-activity-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.admin-activity-item {
  align-items: flex-start;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 13px 0;
}

.admin-activity-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-activity-icon {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--admin-primary-soft);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-primary);
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 32px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 32px;
}

.admin-activity-icon.gold {
  background: var(--admin-gold-soft);
  color: var(--admin-gold);
}

.admin-activity-icon.red {
  background: var(--admin-red-soft);
  color: var(--admin-red);
}

.admin-activity-title {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.admin-activity-title strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-activity-title small,
.admin-activity-item p {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
}

.admin-activity-item p {
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 2px 0 0;
}

.admin-progress-row {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.admin-progress-row:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-progress-row div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.admin-progress-row span {
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.admin-progress-row strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-progress-row p {
  background: var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 999px;
  height: 6px;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.admin-progress-row i {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
}

.admin-progress-row i.gold {
  background: var(--admin-gold);
}

.admin-progress-row i.muted {
  background: var(--admin-muted);
}

.admin-stat-row {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 11px 0;
}

.admin-stat-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-stat-row span {
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.admin-stat-row strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-stat-row small {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
}

.admin-stat-row .green {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--admin-green);
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

.admin-stat-row .green i {
  animation: adminPulse 2s infinite;
  background: #4CAF50;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(76, 175, 80, .4);
  height: 8px;
  width: 8px;
}

.admin-stat-row .red {
  color: var(--admin-red);
}

@keyframes adminPulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(76, 175, 80, .4); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(76, 175, 80, 0); }
}

.admin-chart {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.admin-donut-wrap {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 18px;
}

.admin-donut {
  align-items: center;
  background: conic-gradient(
    var(--admin-primary) 0% 21%,
    var(--admin-gold) 21% 42%,
    #5C8FAB 42% 55%,
    var(--admin-green) 55% 70%,
    #B0856E 70% 83%,
    #9B8EA8 83% 100%
  );
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 110px;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  width: 110px;
}

.admin-donut::after {
  background: var(--admin-card);
  border-radius: 50%;
  content: "";
  height: 72px;
  position: absolute;
  width: 72px;
}

.admin-donut span {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.admin-legend,
.admin-mini-table {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
}

.admin-legend div,
.admin-mini-table div {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
  grid-template-columns: 9px 1fr auto;
}

.admin-mini-table div {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

.admin-legend i {
  border-radius: 2px;
  height: 9px;
  width: 9px;
}

.admin-legend span,
.admin-mini-table span,
.admin-empty {
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.admin-legend strong,
.admin-mini-table strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.admin-dashboard-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-line-card,
.admin-donut-card {
  min-height: 230px;
}

.admin-line-chart {
  display: block;
  height: 190px;
  width: 100%;
}

.admin-line-chart line {
  stroke: var(--admin-border-light);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.admin-line-chart polyline {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--admin-primary);
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  stroke-width: 4;
}

.admin-line-chart circle {
  fill: var(--admin-gold);
  stroke: #fff;
  stroke-width: 3;
}

.admin-chart-axis {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 10px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-left: 18px;
}

.admin-bars {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.admin-bar-row {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr 44px;
}

.admin-bar-row span {
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-bar-row div {
  background: var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 999px;
  height: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.admin-bar-row i {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
}

.admin-panel {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.admin-section-heading {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 18px 20px;
}

.admin-section-heading h2,
.admin-form h2,
.admin-list h2 {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-section-heading span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-empty-state {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
}

.admin-empty-state strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
}

.admin-empty-state span {
  font-size: 12px;
}

.admin-content-switch {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

.admin-table {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.admin-table-row {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 1.55fr 170px 120px 90px;
  min-width: 820px;
  padding: 13px 18px;
}

.admin-table-head {
  background: #FAFAF8;
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-table-row span {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.admin-editor-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 420px) 1fr;
  padding: 20px;
}

.admin-form,
.admin-list {
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 18px;
}

.admin-form h2,
.admin-list h2 {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.admin-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.admin-field input,
.admin-field textarea,
.admin-field select,
.admin-table select {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  width: 100%;
}

.admin-field textarea {
  min-height: 84px;
  resize: vertical;
}

.admin-trilingual-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.admin-trilingual-label {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.admin-trilingual-label > span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-field-error,
.admin-field-warning {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-field-error {
  color: var(--admin-red);
}

.admin-field-warning {
  color: var(--admin-gold);
}

.admin-trilingual-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-trilingual-input {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-two-col {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
}

.admin-check {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 12px;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 8px 0 14px;
}

.admin-primary {
  width: 100%;
}

.admin-primary:disabled,
.admin-btn:disabled,
.admin-danger:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.admin-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.admin-list-item {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 0;
}

.admin-list-item > div:first-child {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-list-item strong,
.admin-list-item span {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.admin-list-actions,
.admin-form-actions {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.admin-list-actions {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.admin-list-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-list-item div {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-list-item strong,
.admin-list-item span {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: normal;
}

.admin-list-item strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.admin-list-item span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.admin-table-card {
  background: var(--admin-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(44, 26, 20, .06);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.admin-table-toolbar {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

.admin-table-title {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-table-search {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--admin-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  gap: 7px;
  min-width: 180px;
  padding: 7px 14px;
}

.admin-table-search input {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  outline: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.admin-filter-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.admin-filter-chips button {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 5px 13px;
}

.admin-filter-chips button.active,
.admin-filter-chips button:hover {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  border-color: var(--admin-primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.admin-native-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.admin-native-table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 12px;
  min-width: 880px;
  width: 100%;
}

.admin-native-table th {
  background: #FAFAF8;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .8px;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-native-table td {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  color: var(--admin-text);
  padding: 13px 18px;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-native-table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-native-table select {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font: inherit;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}

.admin-td-main {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-td-sub {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.admin-td-actions {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.admin-inline-confirm {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.admin-review-error {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  color: var(--admin-red);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 12px;
  gap: 12px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 20px;
}

.admin-reject-box {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.admin-reject-box input {
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-text);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  min-width: 160px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}

.admin-review-editor {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  padding: 0 20px 20px;
}

.admin-review-editor .admin-form {
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.admin-icon-btn {
  align-items: center;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 7px;
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 28px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 28px;
}

.admin-icon-btn:hover {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  border-color: var(--admin-primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.admin-icon-btn.red:hover {
  background: var(--admin-red);
  border-color: var(--admin-red);
}

.admin-badge {
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-flex;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  gap: 5px;
  letter-spacing: .4px;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-badge::before {
  background: currentColor;
  border-radius: 50%;
  content: "";
  height: 5px;
  opacity: .72;
  width: 5px;
}

.admin-badge-green { background: var(--admin-green-soft); color: var(--admin-green); }
.admin-badge-gold { background: var(--admin-gold-soft); color: var(--admin-gold); }
.admin-badge-red { background: var(--admin-red-soft); color: var(--admin-red); }
.admin-badge-blue { background: var(--admin-blue-soft); color: var(--admin-blue); }
.admin-badge-muted { background: var(--admin-border-light); color: var(--admin-muted); }

.admin-table-pagination {
  align-items: center;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 11px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 20px;
}

.admin-table-pagination div {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}

.admin-table-pagination button {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  height: 28px;
  width: 28px;
}

.admin-table-pagination button:first-child {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  border-color: var(--admin-primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.admin-grid-2,
.admin-settings-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-grid-3,
.admin-region-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-kpi-grid-3 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.admin-collection-card,
.admin-region-card {
  background: var(--admin-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(44, 26, 20, .06);
  color: var(--admin-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 20px;
  text-align: left;
  transition: all .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

.admin-collection-card:hover,
.admin-region-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--admin-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(44, 26, 20, .10);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.admin-collection-card > div {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.admin-qa-icon,
.admin-region-card > span {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--admin-primary-soft);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--admin-primary);
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 36px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 36px;
}

.admin-collection-card strong,
.admin-region-card strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-collection-card p {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 6px 0 16px;
}

.admin-collection-card footer {
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 11px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.admin-collection-card footer b {
  color: var(--admin-primary);
}

.admin-national-hero,
.admin-ai-model-card {
  align-items: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--admin-primary-dark) 0%, #5C2318 100%);
  border-radius: 20px;
  color: #FDFBF7;
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 28px;
  position: relative;
}

.admin-national-hero span,
.admin-ai-model-card > span {
  background: rgba(212, 175, 55, .2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, .4);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--admin-gold);
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-national-hero h2,
.admin-ai-model-card h2 {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.admin-national-hero p {
  color: rgba(253, 251, 247, .72);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 560px;
}

.admin-region-card {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}

.admin-region-card small {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.admin-map-placeholder {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--admin-bg);
  border: 1px dashed var(--admin-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  color: var(--admin-secondary);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 280px;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-map-placeholder strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
}

.admin-map-placeholder p {
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-person-row {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr auto;
  padding: 9px 0;
}

.admin-person-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-person-row > span {
  align-items: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--admin-primary), var(--admin-primary-dark));
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  height: 30px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 30px;
}

.admin-person-row strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.admin-person-row small {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
}

.admin-mod-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 9px;
}

.admin-ai-model-card {
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.admin-ai-model-card h2 i {
  animation: adminPulse 2s infinite;
  background: #4CAF50;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  height: 8px;
  margin-left: 8px;
  width: 8px;
}

.admin-ai-model-card div {
  display: flex;
  gap: 28px;
}

.admin-ai-model-card strong {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  font-size: 20px;
  gap: 2px;
}

.admin-ai-model-card small {
  color: rgba(253, 251, 247, .68);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.admin-analytics-chart {
  align-items: flex-end;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 160px;
}

.admin-rank {
  color: var(--admin-primary) !important;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.admin-settings-title {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-setting-row {
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-light);
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 0;
}

.admin-setting-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-setting-row strong {
  color: var(--admin-text);
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.admin-setting-row strong.danger {
  color: var(--admin-red);
}

.admin-setting-row span {
  color: var(--admin-muted);
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.admin-toggle {
  background: var(--admin-primary);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 20px;
  position: relative;
  width: 36px;
}

.admin-toggle::after {
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  content: "";
  height: 14px;
  left: 19px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  transition: all .2s ease;
  width: 14px;
}

.admin-toggle.off {
  background: var(--admin-border);
}

.admin-toggle.off::after {
  left: 3px;
}

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .admin-kpi-grid,
  .admin-quick-actions {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .admin-overview-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-grid-3,
  .admin-region-grid,
  .admin-search-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .admin-command-header,
  .admin-editor-grid,
  .admin-donut-wrap {
    flex-direction: column;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-command-header {
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .admin-header-actions {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .admin-dashboard-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-two-col {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-trilingual-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-grid-2,
  .admin-settings-grid,
  .admin-grid-3,
  .admin-region-grid,
  .admin-kpi-grid-3 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-national-hero {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .admin-table-toolbar,
  .admin-list-item {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .admin-table-search,
  .admin-list-actions,
  .admin-form-actions {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .admin-list-actions .admin-btn,
  .admin-list-actions .admin-danger,
  .admin-form-actions .admin-primary,
  .admin-form-actions .admin-btn {
    flex: 1 1 150px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .admin-kpi-grid,
  .admin-quick-actions,
  .admin-search-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-page {
    gap: 18px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .admin-panel,
  .admin-chart-card,
  .admin-table-card {
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
  }

  .admin-content-switch {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .admin-content-switch button {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .admin-native-table-wrap {
    margin: 0 -16px;
  }
}
```
